name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (verb 'tick' + descriptor 'chapter_palette_animation'). Accurately reflects body: per-frame tick that advances chapter palette-animation phase indices. No Ghidra address residue; the embedded constants 4 (cycle length / tick threshold) and the BDA tick word @ 0x46C are semantic, not address-derived suffixes. The umbrella term 'chapter_palette_animation' correctly covers both phases driven here (slow ambient + fast walk-anim alt).
purpose: Per-frame palette-animation tick for chapter (field/scene) visuals: advances a fast phase index every call and a slow phase index roughly every 4 BIOS ticks.
logic_summary: delta = (int16)BIOS_TICK_WORD - ambient_tick_latch. If delta > 4 OR delta < 0 (i.e. >=4 ticks elapsed, or the 16-bit tick word wrapped/went backwards): advance ambient_palette_anim_idx (++ , wrap 4->0) and re-latch the tick word into ambient_palette_anim_tick_latch. Then unconditionally advance walk_anim_alt_palette_idx (++ , wrap 4->0). Two independent 0..3 cycles: slow ambient cycle gated on the BIOS tick, fast walk-anim cycle advanced once per frame/call. No return value.

returns.semantics: No return value; side effects only on the three module-level globals.

notes: Decompile reads the BDA tick word as raw _DAT_0000046c; src abstracts the same access through the BIOS_TICK_WORD macro (consts.h: production maps to *(volatile uint16*)0x46C, FD2_REPLAY maps to (uint16)fd2_replay_tick()) -- functionally equivalent, not a logic concern. The leading __CHK(4,...) in the decompile is the Watcom compiler-emitted stack-probe/check intrinsic, correctly omitted from src. tick_latch global is declared in globals.h @ 0x53C0F and defined in src/life/main.c. Comment block (palette.c lines 214-220) already concise and accurate and consistent with the Ghidra plate, so left unchanged; no src edit performed, only the shard is committed.
